设计意图： Mutation from crossover_drawdown_atr_002: reduced ATR window from 60 to 20 to increase responsiveness to recent volatility, potentially improving IC while preserving the core drawdown-volatility normalization and cs_rank transform for cross-sectional stability. The drawdown window remains at 60 to maintain the original oversold detection horizon.

因子路由 / 公式 ⚠ FE DSL 暂不支持

(-(close - max(close,60)) / max(close,60)) / ts_atr(20)
依赖列: open, high, low, close, volume

📐 因子表达式 DSL (FactorEngine)

(-(close - max(close,60)) / max(close,60)) / ts_atr(20)
已转 FactorEngine（真实 DSL，parse_expr 验证通过）

🧮 计算步骤（DSL 算子链）

  1. 步骤1：ts_max(close) → 窗口 60 的滚动最大值 (与m_max相同)
  2. 步骤2：subtract(close, v1(ts_max)) → 减法：x - y
  3. 步骤3：neg(v2(subtract)) → 返回-x
  4. 步骤4：ts_max(close) → 窗口 60 的滚动最大值 (与m_max相同)
  5. 步骤5：divide(v3(neg), v4(ts_max)) → 除法：x ÷ y（分母为 0 时返回 0/NaN 保护）
  6. 步骤6：subtract(high, low) → 减法：x - y
  7. 步骤7：subtract(high, pre_close) → 减法：x - y
  8. 步骤8：abs(v7(subtract)) → 计算绝对值
  9. 步骤9：subtract(low, pre_close) → 减法：x - y
  10. 步骤10：abs(v9(subtract)) → 计算绝对值
  11. 步骤11：maximum(v8(abs), v10(abs)) → 逐点取两序列较大值
  12. 步骤12：maximum(v6(subtract), v11(maximum)) → 逐点取两序列较大值
  13. 步骤13：ts_mean(v12(maximum)) → 窗口 20 的滚动均值 (与m_avg相同)
  14. 步骤14：divide(v5(divide), v13(ts_mean)) → 除法：x ÷ y（分母为 0 时返回 0/NaN 保护）

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 rolling_max：close.rolling(window=60, min_periods=60).max()
  2. 计算 drawdown：(close - rolling_max) / rolling_max
  3. 计算 high：high.values.astype(float)
  4. 计算 low：low.values.astype(float)
  5. 计算 close：close.values.astype(float)
  6. 计算 atr：pd.Series(talib.ATR(high, low, close, timeperiod=20), index=df_copy.index)
  7. 计算 normalized：-drawdown / atr

🔍 公式逐行拆解（算子释义）

  1. max(close,60) — max(x, n) → 滚动最大 / 逐点最大
  2. max(close,60) — max(x, n) → 滚动最大 / 逐点最大
  3. ATR(20) — talib.ATR(high, low, close, n) → 平均真实波幅

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_drawdown_atr_20_normalized(df): df_copy = df.copy() rolling_max = df_copy["str">'close'].rolling(window=60, min_periods=60).max() drawdown = (df_copy["str">'close'] - rolling_max) / rolling_max high = df_copy["str">'high'].values.astype(float) low = df_copy["str">'low'].values.astype(float) close = df_copy["str">'close'].values.astype(float) atr = pd.Series(talib.ATR(high, low, close, timeperiod=20), index=df_copy.index) normalized = -drawdown / atr.replace(0, np.nan) df_copy["str">'factor_drawdown_atr_20_normalized'] = normalized.fillna(0) "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["str">'factor_drawdown_atr_20_normalized']
